from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque, defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            minr = min(y for y,x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-minr, x-minc) for y,x in cells)
            components.append((color, cells, shape))
    shape_colors = defaultdict(list)
    for i, (color, cells, shape) in enumerate(components):
        shape_colors[shape].append(i)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells, shape in components:
        if color == 1:
            partners = [components[i][0] for i in shape_colors[shape] if components[i][0] != 1]
            if partners:
                new_color = partners[0]
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = new_color
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-9d820258.py'
file.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(file),'exec'),globals())
print('saved',file)
